requirements.summary: Normative English term for «асеть / асеть связей» is ANet. Aset is not an MTS English term; legacy Aset/aset code identifiers have no terminology or semantic authority.

One v0.15 execution-core semantic authority path: universal FORMAL and canonical JSON converge to the same native source ANet, then shared resolution/denotation/compiler/Γ execution/projection; no consumer-specific host semantic path is authoritative.
FORMAL_MIGRATED or VERTICAL_GREEN requires tracked canonical FORMAL artifact, entry, digest, profile and evidence.
One-Link ontology: host kinds do not acquire MTS semantic authority.
Prefer ordinary Link + ExactSequence + self-reference topology before extending Grammar.
Presentation names carry no semantic authority; topology-preserving rename preserves behavior.

The v0.15 direct FORMAL/JSON source path preserves the already accepted ROOT/START/END/PAIR structural aspect constructors and lowers them to native Link topology / recursive 8/9/6/1 without enabling arbitrary cyclic bindings.
VERTICAL_GREEN requires transitive semantic dependency closure for the declared artifact scope.
Every dependency outside the artifact is explicitly classified and versioned.
Program-specific host semantic injection budget is exactly zero. Generic orchestration and backend compatibility/optimization lowerings may exist but have no MTS semantic authority.
A canonical FORMAL executable artifact reconstructs its executable package in fresh Memory using only fixed generic authorities.
Canonical JSON alone reconstructs the same package in fresh Memory without source-specific repair.
Two fresh Memories with unrelated allocation noise preserve canonical recursive representation and behavior.

Every FORMAL name is contextual. Absolute name :A is shorthand for R:A; no host-global atom namespace is semantic authority. Structured expressions resolve their endpoint names through the same contextual-name resolver before Link construction.
JSON losslessly projects the complete supported canonical source ANet/model, not only passive carriers.
FORMAL text and direct JSON converge to the same native source ANet roles, resolver and DAS denotation path before semantics.
Semantic JSON mutations must predictably change or reject source/denotation/execution behavior; transport-only mutations must not create semantic authority.
VERTICAL_GREEN requires the complete mandatory evidence bundle and zero semantic injection.
Completion state may only come from registered evidence, never PR/issue/test naming or partial round-trip.

A compact Author-gated Boolean AND source ANet contains only the exact local T/F truth-table semantics expressed as zero-role Rules; legacy RoleDictionary/index/Scope/interpreter scaffolding is not canonical source.

Boolean AND executes through the shared matcher/Γ-compatible path and frozen compatibility adapter with zero AND-specific host dispatch; operands outside the local T/F domain are NO_MATCH rather than pass-through.

MTS has one canonical semantic Boolean AND source/model. Frozen or future A-memory backends may use generated compatibility or optimized AND lowerings only when they are semantics-preserving with respect to the exact T/F-domain truth table and NO_MATCH boundary, remain generic/backend-owned, and stay outside canonical AND semantic authority.

Author-gated strict Boolean NOT/OR/XOR reuse the exact same FORMAL/JSON source model, semantic Theory->Rule discovery, zero-role Rule topology, generic Γ-compatible execution path and generic frozen-backend lowering as approved AND; no operator-specific semantic/runtime path is permitted.

Theory, Context/currentness, interpreter/meta-program, entry and result execution roles are represented by Links and semantic ANet membership. Host package/launch code may perform only generic selection/orchestration allowed by the machine contract and cannot supply semantic role authority.

The same Link may have different execution roles under different selected ANet contexts only because the corresponding contextual Link memberships differ; host names, manifests or pointers cannot create those roles.

One repeated universal Γ is the shared v0.15 semantic execution operation for ordinary executable ANets and self-hosted meta/interpreter ANets: reaction-start snapshot; J0 structural-unary applicability over one explicit current endpoint; S1 read-only structural match/bind; S2 substitution/canonical Link construction during synthesis; 0/1/N ordered image contribution; complete staged successor and atomic publication. Exact grounded MP is the zero-role refinement. J1 cross-current-member join, external semantic grounder commands, consumer-specific opcodes and a second semantic runtime are not required/permitted by the selected profile.
Lean4 and Rocq independently formalize the supported v0.15 FORMAL mathematical core and classify exact premises/domain/exclusions for contextual names, source denotation, DAS and ExactSequence.

Paired external assurance proves/cross-checks semantic preservation of FORMAL/JSON convergence and canonical recursive 8/9/6/1 metacompilation for the declared fragment; corpus GREEN alone is not proof of soundness.
JSON arrays lower canonically to ExactSequence of already-denoted element Links; []=R. R-rooted fold F_R is a separate derived projection, not the positional/execution carrier.
Source bytes, native source ANet, resolution/denotation, semantic ANet, recursive metacompilation, backend compatibility lowering, execution/replay and projection remain separately observable.
Read/find/validation are read-only; materialization/publication is explicit and failure-safe.
Every semantic capability has positive, structural mutation, missing authority, context, identity, JSON mutation and fresh-memory falsifiers as applicable.
Machine-readable candidate v0.15 requirements/traceability registry governs completion state.
Acceptance corpus audits direct semantic construction and rejects hidden program-specific host injection or backend-specific semantic authority.
Roadmap/status projections derive completion from registry/evidence rather than hand-maintained prose.

Every Author-approved v0.15 executable artifact is pinned and replayed through FORMAL/JSON -> native source ANet -> semantic ANet -> recursive 8/9/6/1 -> generic compatibility lowering where required -> frozen A-memory 0.175.0, with zero semantic backend patches.

Normal MTS merge paths cannot bypass required CI/repo-guard enforcement: broad always-bypass repository roles are removed or contained to an explicitly audited emergency actor/process, and an intentional RED repo-guard pull request is mechanically blocked from merging until restored GREEN.

The canonical «Формальная нотация МТС.md» is a deterministic generated projection of the current v0.15 execution-core FORMAL/JSON model, machine registries, selected Gamma/context profiles and Author-approved executable corpus; hand-maintained semantic prose and stale v0.14-only projection are forbidden.
RELEASE_READY is impossible while any mandatory requirement is below VERTICAL_GREEN or explicitly resolved release state.
Independent readiness audit attempts to falsify hidden semantics, incomplete JSON, drift, omissions and nondeterminism.
Only explicit Author ACCEPT/REJECT can change accepted/current from v0.14 to v0.15.
Every new canonical logical/executable JSON artifact in v0.15 stops at AUTHOR_REVIEW_PENDING before completion. Proof/aprover artifacts are separately Author-gated in v0.16.
v0.15 Author review shows exact FORMAL, exact JSON, source/semantic mapping, external/backend boundary, round-trip, fresh executable replay and falsifiers.
Author decision is recorded per exact artifact revision/digest; material changes invalidate prior approval.
Author JSON review applies throughout v0.15; batch approval only for an explicitly shown exact batch.
Every Author-approved JSON enters the permanent executable regression corpus.
Every FORMAL/model/JSON/metacompiler/recursive/execution change that can affect v0.15 executable semantics replays the complete Author-approved executable JSON corpus.
Approved JSON/evidence is never silently regenerated; incompatible changes use explicit migration and renewed Author approval.
